evals.prompt: Audit this hero section: dark navy background, cyan-to-purple gradient headline 'The Future of Intelligent Work', a glowing brain illustration, logos of Google, Stripe and Notion under 'Trusted by', and three identical feature cards. The product is an invoice-matching tool for accounting teams.
evals.expected_output: Leads with the largest problem (the hero does not show the invoice-matching task), flags the unsupported customer logos as invented social proof, recommends a few high-impact changes (concrete offer and action, real product surface, neutral surfaces with one accent), and does not claim checks it did not perform.

assertions.name: leads_with_largest_problem
assertions.description: Starts with the most damaging issue rather than a long undifferentiated list.

assertions.name: flags_unsupported_proof
assertions.description: Calls out the customer logos as unsupported unless the user confirms they are real.

assertions.name: product_specific_fix
assertions.description: Replaces the abstract AI motif with the product's actual task or surface.

assertions.name: few_high_impact_changes
assertions.description: Recommends a small number of prioritized changes.

evals.prompt: Our brand is intentionally vibrant: magenta primary color, playful illustrations, dark mode by default. Make the settings page feel less AI-generated.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the vibrant brand, illustrations, and dark mode; targets only unjustified patterns (e.g., uniform cards, decorative badges, nonsemantic glow) and avoids forcing a bland or beige redesign.

assertions.name: preserves_brand
assertions.description: Keeps magenta, playful illustration, and dark mode instead of rejecting them as common.

assertions.name: avoids_forced_blandness
assertions.description: Does not push the design toward beige, monochrome, or minimalism by default.

evals.prompt: Here is our product page code for a coffee grinder store. Remove the generic AI look and implement the changes.
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes product info, price, variants, and purchase controls; edits code with semantic HTML and existing tokens; does not invent delivery or return policies; reports which renders were actually checked.

assertions.name: ecommerce_priorities
assertions.description: Puts product information, price, variants, and purchase action first.

assertions.name: no_invented_policies
assertions.description: Does not invent shipping, return, or guarantee details.

assertions.name: honest_verification
assertions.description: States which checks were performed and which were not.
